note: Channeled Boseiju on a tapped Volcanic; B fetched an untapped Volcanic and the dead land was its 4th delve card, so Murktide cost exactly B's 3 t6 lands. Playing Boseiju as a land kept a second G source (no Misty+Tomb payment, 3 life, on the t9 Aluren).

Ponder showed Prismari Charm, Daze, Island; B shuffled. Against Alurentell, Charm (bounces Aluren in response to Acererak) and Daze (Force pitch) are the anti-combo cards; Delta/Wasteland already covered lands.
Brainstorm put-back Daze (then Delta shuffle) over Bolt. Held, Daze is the blue pitch for FoW #74 on the t9 Aluren, which A could not have answered (A's FoW had no pitch).

Forced back A's Force on Murktide, pitching Preordain, its last blue card. Letting Murktide die keeps FoW+Preordain for Aluren (and no DRC surveil); forcing back got the 5/5 clock that put A to 10. Same spot as g79 b61, where not forcing back won.

Wasteland on Ancient Tomb vs Hedge Maze. A's G sources were Maze + Misty; killing Maze leaves one G so Aluren (GG) is off on t9, while Show and Tell is castable either way. Tomb hit let the t9 Aluren happen.
